import numpy as np
Z=np.load('heads.npz'); AQ=Z['AQ'];AK=Z['AK']
W=np.load('blocks.npz')
theta=1e6**(-np.arange(64)/64)
def R(d):
    c=np.cos(theta*d);s=np.sin(theta*d)
    M=np.zeros((128,128));i=np.arange(64)
    M[i,i]=c;M[i+64,i+64]=c;M[i,i+64]=s;M[i+64,i]=-s
    return M
def score(q,k,d): return q@R(d)@k
others=[0]+list(range(2,17))+[24,32,48,64,128]
X=R(1)-np.mean([R(d) for d in others],0)
res=[]
for i in range(448):
    l=i//16
    rq=AQ[i]/W[f'qn_w.{l}'][:,None]; rk=AK[i]/W[f'kn_w.{l}'][:,None]
    Aq=AQ[i]*np.sqrt(128)/np.linalg.norm(rq); Ak=AK[i]*np.sqrt(128)/np.linalg.norm(rk)
    Bm=np.vstack([Aq,Ak])
    Y=np.zeros((256,256));Y[:128,128:]=X/2;Y[128:,:128]=X.T/2
    U,s,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Bm,full_matrices=False)
    Mh=np.diag(s)@U.T@Y@U@np.diag(s)
    ev,evec=np.linalg.eigh(Mh)
    u=Vt.T@(evec[:,-1]/1)  
    u=u/np.linalg.norm(u)*np.sqrt(1024)
    q=Aq@u;k=Ak@u
    ker=np.array([score(q,k,d) for d in range(0,33)])/np.sqrt(128)
    res.append((ev[-1]*1024/np.sqrt(128),ker))
np.save('ptok.npy',np.array([np.concatenate([[r[0]],r[1]]) for r in res]))
v=np.array([r[0] for r in res])
o=np.argsort(-v)[:25]
for i in o:
    k=res[i][1]
    print(f'L{i//16}H{i%16}',round(v[i],1),'ker0-8',np.round(k[:9],1),'k16',round(k[16],1),'k32',round(k[32],1),'margin',round(k[1]-max(k[0],k[2:].max()),1))
print('median',np.median(v))
"
